summary: The required runtime beneath @lottiefiles/dotlottie-react. It is active, MIT, provenance-signed and dependency-free, and it supports both .lottie and Lottie JSON. The WASM engine is self-hostable; the only material cost is the ~481 KB gzip WASM plus the browser-only canvas runtime.
reasoning: Active release line: 0.82.1 published 2026-11-02, with commits on the same day.
Zero runtime dependencies and no install scripts.
MIT, with a permissive runtime tree.
The npm tarball is provenance-signed and published by GitHub Actions through a trusted publisher.
Supports .lottie and Lottie JSON, plus the worker variant for off-main-thread rendering.
The WASM and worker are shipped in the package and can be copied to a self-hosted path; setWasmUrl() and setWorkerUrl() are public APIs.
The React spike loaded both formats through this runtime and reported 90 frames for each.
caveats: The WASM engine is about 1.2 MB uncompressed / 481 KB gzip and is fetched separately from the JS. Self-host and cache it.
The default path fetches the version-pinned WASM from jsDelivr or unpkg. That is an external runtime dependency unless setWasmUrl() is used.
Strict CSP may need wasm-unsafe-eval; the worker path needs worker-src, or a self-hosted worker via setWorkerUrl().
Browser/canvas runtime. Node 18.17 can import the package, but this requirement uses it in the browser.
0.x versioning. Pin 0.82.1 exactly; the React wrapper pins it exactly too.
The spike covered simple playback, not state machines, themes, audio or very large .lottie files.

evidence.label: Format support
evidence.detail: Loads .lottie data and Lottie JSON strings/objects. The React wrapper exposes the same support through src/data.

evidence.label: Dependency footprint
evidence.detail: 0 runtime dependencies; 7 MB installed; 7.1 MB unpacked including the WASM and worker.

evidence.label: Install scripts
evidence.detail: No preinstall, install or postinstall script.

evidence.label: TypeScript types
evidence.detail: Bundled dist/index.d.ts for the main entry, plus ./webgl and ./webgpu subpaths.

evidence.label: Maintenance
evidence.detail: 0.82.1 published 2026-11-02; repository pushed 2026-11-02; active, 938 stars and 21 open issues.

evidence.label: npm provenance
evidence.detail: SLSA provenance is present on 0.82.1; npm records GitHub Actions as the publisher via a trusted publisher.

evidence.label: Self-hostable assets
evidence.detail: dotlottie-player.wasm (1.2 MB / 481 KB gzip) and dotlottie.worker.js (73 KB) ship in the package and are exported subpaths. setWasmUrl() and setWorkerUrl() are public APIs.

evidence.label: React browser spike
evidence.detail: The runtime rendered .lottie and JSON side by side through @lottiefiles/dotlottie-react in Chrome 1200x800; both reached 90 frames with no page errors.
